<reason>CON won the decisive line-drawing and inclusion clash. PRO offered a clear public-vs-secret rule, but CON's pressure on what counts as a coupon and how to prove willingness vs scarcity exposed it as unworkable, and PRO's audit-swap answer conceded differential mercy discounts would be illegal.
